name: How long does it take to repair a kitchen door frame?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a kitchen door frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen door frame repair varies depending on the severity and type of damage. Minor repairs, such as filling small cracks or tightening loose components, might take a few hours. More extensive work, like replacing a section of the frame due to significant rot or damage, could take one to two days. A complete frame replacement, including drying times for fillers or paint, may extend to several days. We provide an estimated timeline after a thorough assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor repairs take a few hours, while extensive damage or full replacement can take one to several days, depending on the severity.
